title: The Wolf of the Ninefold Court
author: C. M. Reyes
blurb: Petra Reyes, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
